1.text: Recite in the name of your Lord who created –

2.text: Created man from a clinging substance.

3.text: Recite, and your Lord is the most Generous -

5.text: Taught man that which he knew not.

8.text: Indeed, to your Lord is the return.

9.text: Have you seen the one who forbids

11.text: Have you seen if he is upon guidance

13.text: Have you seen if he denies and turns away -

14.text: Does he not know that Allāh sees?

15.text: No! If he does not desist, We will surely drag him by the forelock<sup foot_note="228258">1</sup> –

footnotes.228258: - It may also mean "slap him" or "blacken his face at the forelock."

17.text: Then let him call his associates;

18.text: We will call the angels of Hell.<sup foot_note="228259">1</sup>

footnotes.228259: - Those who push the wicked into the Fire.

19.text: No! Do not obey him. But prostrate and draw near [to Allāh].
